   ```kotlin
   fun resolveTargetIndex(client: ElasticsearchClient, collection: Collection): String {
       val baseId = collection.baseId
       return runCatching {
           val aliasMap = client.indices().getAlias { it.name(baseId) }
           val currentIndex = aliasMap.keys().firstOrNull()
           when {
               currentIndex == null -> "$baseId-a"
               currentIndex.endsWith("-a") -> "$baseId-b"
               else -> "$baseId-a"
           }
       }.getOrDefault("$baseId-a")
   }

   private fun swapAlias(client: ElasticsearchClient, baseId: String, newIndex: String) {
       val oldIndex = runCatching {
           client.indices().getAlias { it.name(baseId) }.keys().firstOrNull()
       }.getOrNull()
       client.indices().updateAliases { req ->
           if (oldIndex != null && oldIndex != newIndex) {
               req.actions { a -> a.remove { it.index(oldIndex).alias(baseId) } }
           }
           req.actions { a -> a.add { it.index(newIndex).alias(baseId) } }
       }
   }
   ```

   ```kotlin
   val aliasResponse = client.indices().getAlias { it.name(baseId) }
   val currentIndex = aliasResponse.result().keys.firstOrNull()  // result() returns Map<String, IndexAliases>
   ```
